== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Infuriating Heat]].
*[[Soothing]] can be used to stop foes gaining the advantage of Infuriating Heat.
*At 30 seconds with zero rank in [[Expertise]], it can be maintained by any profession.
